tests.title: The journal is written mode 0600 in a 0700 recovery directory by atomic synced replacement and never removed by the worker
given: an empty attempt directory
tests.when: the journal is written twice, with a concurrent reader polling journal.json in a loop, and the worker's attempt cleanup runs
then: recovery/ has mode 0700 and journal.json has mode 0600
every read parses as either the first or the second complete document
no temporary file is left behind
recovery/ and journal.json still exist after the worker's cleanup
tests.pseudocode: for i in 1..2: j.Write(state_i); reader goroutine: b=read(journal.json); assert json.Valid(b) and (decode(b)==state_1 or state_2); assert stat(recovery).mode==0700; assert stat(journal).mode==0600; worker.Cleanup(); assert exists(journal)

tests.title: A journal written after a full fix delivery decodes with every documented field
given: a fix attempt run to completion against the fake hub with the scripted brain
tests.when: recovery/journal.json is decoded into the journal document
then: format version, job id, attempt number and kind are set
clone dir is relative to the attempt dir and hub_url carries no user information
forge repository, pinned brain, model, profile, landing mode, budget and turn bound are present
run id, base branch, base head, session id, session run id and completed flag are present
each lease has sandbox id, expires_at and released flag
each delivery has handover count, start time and ending
brain spend, landing plan, landing steps pushed, hub_push, pull_request and mirror steps status_labels, comment and report steps usage_posted, events_posted, session_completed are present
tests.pseudocode: j = decode(read(recovery/journal.json)); assert j.Version>0; assert j.Job==jobID; assert !contains(j.HubURL,'@'); assert len(j.Leases)==1 and j.Leases[0].Released; assert j.Landing.PullRequest.Number>0; assert j.Report.SessionCompleted

tests.title: No file under recovery/ ever contains the PAT, a lease token, an Authorization value or a URL with user information
given: a fake hub issuing a distinctive PAT and distinctive lease tokens, with clone URLs that embed credentials for the git process
tests.when: for any delivery sequence drawn from first delivery, stage-abort at any named stage then resume, shutdown then resume, transient error then resume, and box replacement
then: a byte search of every file under recovery/ for the PAT and for every lease token issued finds no match
no file contains the string Authorization: or a scheme://user:pass@ URL
tests.pseudocode: for seq in gen_delivery_sequences(): run(seq); for f in walk(attempt/recovery): b=read(f); assert !contains(b, pat); for t in leaseTokens: assert !contains(b,t); assert !regex('://[^/@\s]+@').match(b)

tests.title: When the landing plan cannot be journalled the delivery writes nothing to hub's git server or the forge and returns a transient io error
given: a fix attempt with an accepted and applied change
journal writes made to fail exactly when the landing plan is written
tests.when: the delivery reaches the landing
then: the runner returns an error carrying toolio.Failure with category io and retryable true
the fake hub records zero git pushes, zero branch push route calls and zero forge writes for the delivery
the clone is kept
tests.pseudocode: inject(journal.FailOn('landing_plan')); err = runner.Run(req); f = AsFailure(err); assert f.Category=='io' && f.Retryable; assert hub.Count('git push')==0; assert forge.Writes()==0; assert exists(clone)

tests.title: A journal write failure other than the landing plan raises journal_unwritable once and the delivery completes normally
given: a fix attempt where every journal write except the landing plan fails
tests.when: the delivery runs through to its outcome
then: the envelope carries exactly one journal_unwritable warning
the result is done with one pull request, as an uninterrupted delivery returns
tests.pseudocode: inject(journal.FailAllExcept('landing_plan')); env = run(); assert count(env.warnings, 'journal_unwritable')==1; assert env.status=='done'; assert forge.PullRequests()==1

tests.title: A delivery stopped for a shutdown or ending in a transient error posts no usage, no events, leaves the session open and writes no outcome file
given: a fix attempt in a leased box with a parked interrupted branch after a stop mid-loop
tests.when: one delivery is cancelled with a shutdown cause and another delivery returns a transient error
then: the fake hub records zero POST /sessions/:id/usage, zero events batches and zero session completions for each delivery
the lease is released and the journal records released true and the delivery ending as shutdown or transient
recovery/outcome.json does not exist
the clone, the run directory and the parked local branch are unchanged
tests.pseudocode: for cause in [shutdown, transient]: run(cause); assert hub.Count('usage')==0; assert hub.Count('events')==0; assert hub.Count('complete')==0; assert j.Leases[0].Released; assert j.Deliveries[-1].Ending==cause; assert !exists(outcome.json)

tests.title: A shutdown writes nothing to the forge and a transient error removes the in-progress label
given: a fix attempt whose issue carries the in-progress label
tests.when: a delivery is stopped for a shutdown, and another attempt's delivery returns a transient error
then: after the shutdown the fake forge records zero writes
after the transient error the issue no longer carries the in-progress status label
tests.pseudocode: run(shutdown); assert forge.Writes()==0; run(transient); assert !labels(issue).Contains('af:in-progress')

tests.title: A first delivery removes a leftover clone and journal and starts fresh
given: an attempt directory holding a stale clone and a stale journal
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 1
then: the stale clone and journal are gone before the run
the fake hub records one clone request and one POST /sessions
tests.pseudocode: seed(attempt/clone, attempt/recovery/journal.json); run(count=1); assert hub.Count('clone')==1; assert hub.Count('POST /sessions')==1; assert !contains(newJournal, staleMarker)

tests.title: A later delivery with nothing to discard starts as a first delivery without a resume_discarded warning and reuses an open session
given: delivery 1 failed transiently at resolve, leaving no journal and no clone
a second case with a journal recording an uncompleted session and no completed clone, and a partial clone directory
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2
then: the envelope carries no resume_discarded warning
the partial clone is removed and a clone request is sent
in the second case the fake hub records zero additional POST /sessions
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert !has(env.warnings,'resume_discarded'); assert hub.Count('clone')==1; case2: assert hub.Count('POST /sessions')==priorSessions

tests.title: A resumed delivery sends no clone request and keeps the settings the run started with when hub values changed
given: delivery 1 stopped after the apply stage
hub workspace variables changed since: base branch, landing mode, model and budget
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2
then: no clone request is sent
base, base head, table and baseline come from fix.json and brain, model, profile, landing mode, budget and turn bound from the journal
the run's outcome matches the pinned settings, not the changed values
AF_TIMEOUT is read afresh and AF_MAX_ATTEMPTS is the current value returned with the result
tests.pseudocode: hub.SetVar('AF_MAX_BUDGET_USD','0.01'); hub.SetBase('other'); run(count=2); assert hub.Count('clone')==0; assert landedBase==pinnedBase; assert session.model==journal.model

tests.title: Resolve checks apply to the current values on a resumed delivery
given: delivery 1 interrupted after the apply stage
the workspace has since moved to carry_patch landing
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2
then: the delivery is refused with the worker's carry_patch refusal
no lease is taken and no brain is run
tests.pseudocode: hub.SetLandMode('carry_patch'); env = run(count=2); assert env.error.category==workerCarryPatchRefusalCategory; assert hub.Count('lease')==0

tests.title: Each rejected resume condition raises resume_discarded with its reason and starts from a fresh clone on the same attempt
given: a journal and clone left by delivery 1, rejected in turn by: garbled journal, clone not a work tree, changed hub_url origin, changed forge repository, missing run directory, torn ledger
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2 for each case
then: the envelope carries resume_discarded naming journal_unreadable, clone_invalid, origin_changed, forge_repository_changed, run_missing or ledger_unreadable respectively
one clone request is sent and the job keeps the same attempt number
with a readable journal the unreleased leases were released and a recorded uncompleted session gets zero additional POST /sessions and is the one completed
tests.pseudocode: for (mutate, reason) in cases: setup(); mutate(); env = run(count=2); assert warn(env,'resume_discarded').reason==reason; assert hub.Count('clone')==1; assert attemptNo==1

tests.title: An unreadable ledger discards the resume but delivery 1's spend, session and run id carry over
given: delivery 1 spent 0.40 USD in one brain run recorded in the journal and was stopped before apply
the run's ledger then corrupted so a line does not parse
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2
then: resume_discarded carries reason ledger_unreadable
the brain's budget option is the pinned budget minus 0.40
the envelope usage includes delivery 1's spend
delivery 1's session is completed and the fake hub records no second POST /sessions
tests.pseudocode: corrupt(ledger); env = run(count=2); assert w.reason=='ledger_unreadable'; assert brainOpts.Budget==pinned-0.40; assert env.usage.cost>=0.40; assert hub.Count('POST /sessions')==1; assert session.completed

tests.title: A resumed delivery reports to the journal's open session, or opens a new session when it was completed, and tells the recorder
given: a journal recording an uncompleted session in one case and a completed session with unposted usage in another
tests.when: a resumed delivery runs to the outcome
then: in the first case the delivery posts to the recorded session and opens none
in the second case it opens one new session with the run's run id and posts only usage not recorded as posted
the recorder's session id and run id equal the session in effect
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert hub.Count('POST /sessions')==expected; assert recorder.Session==sessionPostedTo; assert recorder.RunID==journal.RunID

tests.title: Unreleased journal leases are released before the delivery takes its own lease
given: a journal recording two leases as unreleased, one of which hub already deleted (404)
tests.when: a resumed delivery that must lease a box runs
then: the fake hub records DELETE of each unreleased lease before POST /workspaces/:slug/sandboxes
the 404 lease is counted as released and the journal marks both released
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); reqs=hub.Requests(); assert idx(DELETE l1)<idx(POST sandboxes); assert idx(DELETE l2)<idx(POST sandboxes); assert all(j.Leases[:2].Released)

tests.title: A disagreement the resume rules do not cover ends the attempt failed with category internal and publishes nothing
given: a resumed fix attempt whose base branch has commits without the run's Agent-Fox-Run trailer
a second case where the run's branch is on hub's git server at a commit other than the plan's
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2
then: the envelope is failed with error category internal, retryable false and a message naming what was found
no push, pull request or comment is made
cleanup is as for any failed attempt
tests.pseudocode: env=run(count=2); assert env.status=='failed'; assert env.error.category=='internal' && !env.error.retryable; assert contains(env.error.message,'trailer'); assert forge.Writes()==0

tests.title: The brain is skipped only when every submission condition holds
given: a run directory with a valid submission.json, a matching last submission_accepted record and an apply record
tests.when: the skip decision is evaluated while each condition is broken in turn: wrong kind, wrong run_id, payload hash mismatch, last submission_accepted hash differs, payload fails submission.Check against the tree, fix report with no apply record after the accepted record
then: with all conditions met the decision is skip and the scripted brain is not invoked
each broken condition makes the decision run the brain
a fix question with no apply record still skips
a triage diagnosis is checked with triage.Validate
tests.pseudocode: assert Skip(rd)==true; for broken in cases: assert Skip(broken)==false; assert Skip(questionWithoutApply)==true

tests.title: An unpushed parked interrupted commit is brought back into the working tree and the branch name is reused without a suffix
given: a fix attempt stopped during the land so that the applied change sits on a local branch of commit(s) all carrying Agent-Fox-Run: <run id>
the run's change is not on hub's git server
tests.when: the resumed delivery skips the brain and lands
then: the base branch is checked out at the base head with the change in the working tree
the local parked branch is deleted
the pushed branch name equals the name an uninterrupted run would use, with no -2 suffix
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert git.CurrentBranch()==base || landedBranch==expected; assert !git.LocalBranchExists(parked); assert hub.PushedBranch=='fix/42-'+slug; assert !endsWith(branch,'-2')

tests.title: When the brain runs again the clone is reset to the base head and fix.json's round count carries on
given: delivery 1 recorded one round in fix.json and left a partial change plus a local run branch in the clone
the ledger has no accepted submission with an apply record
tests.when: the resumed delivery runs the fix loop
then: the hard reset and clean keeping .agent-fox/ remove the partial change and untracked files but keep the run directory
every local branch of the run is deleted
the first resumed round starts from the base head with no earlier refusal and carries the earlier questions
fix.json's round count after the delivery equals the rounds before plus the rounds run
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert firstRoundTreeClean; assert !git.LocalBranchExists(runBranch); assert st.Rounds==before+ran; assert exists(rundir/ledger)

tests.title: A refusal in a resumed loop is fed to the next round within bounds and the loop ends through fix.Finish
given: a resumed fix delivery whose scripted brain first submits a change the gate refuses, then a passing one
tests.when: the resumed loop runs
then: the second round's task carries the refusal
the loop ends through fix.Finish with a landed pull request
fix.json's round count advances by two
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert round2.Task.contains(refusal); assert env.status=='done'; assert st.Rounds==before+2

tests.title: A resumed triage delivery reuses the clone and reruns the triage loop in the same run directory
given: a triage attempt interrupted before its submission was accepted
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2
then: no clone request is sent
the triage loop runs in the same run directory and run id
the attempt completes
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert hub.Count('clone')==0; assert runDir==journal.RunDir; assert brain.Invocations==1

tests.title: A brain run on a resumed delivery gets the pinned budget and turns minus the attempt's spend

delivery 1 spent 0.30 USD and 5 turns recorded in brain_end
tests.when: the resumed delivery's brain starts
then: the brain options carry budget 0.70 and turn bound 15
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); o=scripted.LastOptions(); assert approx(o.MaxBudget,0.70); assert o.MaxTurns==15

tests.title: With no budget or no turns left the attempt ends failed with category budget and the brain does not run
given: delivery 1 spent the whole budget, in one case, and all turns in another
tests.when: the runner is called with handover count 2 and the brain would run
then: the envelope is failed with error category budget and retryable false

tests.title: A brain_start with no brain_end counts as zero spend and raises brain_spend_unrecorded with sequence and round
given: a run ledger holding brain_start at seq N for round R, with no brain_end before the next brain_start or the end of ledger
another brain run with a brain_end of 0.20 USD
tests.when: a resumed delivery computes the attempt's spend
then: the cut-short run counts as zero against the budget and usage
usage cost equals only the recorded brain_end 0.20
the envelope carries brain_spend_unrecorded naming seq N and round R

tests.title: The journal's brain spend is refreshed after a brain run ends and equals carried spend plus the ledger's brain_end sum
given: a carried spend of 0.10 USD and a run with two brain runs of 0.20 and 0.15
tests.when: the journal is read after the second brain run
then: journal spend cost is 0.45 with cost source, input tokens, output tokens and turns summed
tests.pseudocode: run(); j=read(journal); assert approx(j.Spend.Cost,0.10+sum(brain_end.cost_usd)); assert j.Spend.InputTokens==sum(brain_end.input_tokens)

tests.title: A discarded resume carries over the larger of the journal's spend and the previous carry plus the removed ledger's spend
given: a journal spend of 0.30 and a readable removed ledger with brain_end totalling 0.50 plus carried 0.10
a second case with journal spend 0.90 and ledger 0.20 with carry 0.10
a third case where the ledger does not read
tests.when: the carry-over is computed
then: the first case carries 0.60
the second carries 0.90
the third carries the journal's recorded spend
tests.pseudocode: assert Carry(0.30,0.10,ledger(0.50))==0.60; assert Carry(0.90,0.10,ledger(0.20))==0.90; assert Carry(j,c,unreadable)==j

tests.title: Every brain_end ledger record carries integer input_tokens and output_tokens
given: brain.Execute run with the scripted brain returning an Outcome with 1200 input and 340 output tokens
tests.when: the run ledger is read
then: the brain_end record decodes with input_tokens 1200 and output_tokens 340 beside the existing fields
a brain that reports no tokens records zero integers
tests.pseudocode: Execute(req); e=lastRecord(ledger,'brain_end'); assert e.input_tokens==1200 && e.output_tokens==340; assert hasKey(e,'cost_usd')

tests.title: The reported usage always equals the carried spend plus the current ledger's brain_end records
given: a fake hub and the scripted brain with generated per-run costs and tokens
tests.when: for any number of deliveries, any split of brain runs between deliveries and any carried spend
then: the done envelope's usage cost, tokens and turns equal the carried spend plus the sum of the current ledger's brain_end records
the hub usage record holds the same total
tests.pseudocode: for plan in gen_splits(): run_all(plan); assert env.usage==carried+sum(ledger.brain_end); assert hub.usage.total==env.usage

tests.title: The landing plan is journalled before the first push

then: journal.json holds the plan (branch, commit, outcome, status, verdict, closes-issue, PR title, body, draft, warnings) before the fake hub records the push
tests.pseudocode: hub.OnPush(func(){ j=read(journal); assert j.Landing.Plan!=nil && j.Landing.Plan.Branch==pushedBranch })

tests.title: A change already on hub's git server is finished from the plan without measuring, leasing or running the brain
given: delivery 1 pushed the plan's branch and recorded the pull request, then stopped
tests.when: delivery 2 reads the remote with the PAT
then: nothing is measured or committed again and no lease is requested
the result reports the plan's branch, commit and verdict and delivery 1's pull request
the fake hub records zero new pull requests
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert hub.Count('lease')==0; assert hub.PullRequests()==1; assert env.result.branch==plan.Branch && env.result.commit==plan.Commit; assert brain.Invocations==0

tests.title: Across all deliveries of one attempt at most one pull request, one created issue and one comment per marker are made
given: a fix attempt and a triage-of-text attempt on the fake forge
tests.when: for any choice of crash stages (a stage-abort after any named stage, repeated over several deliveries)
then: the fake forge records at most one pull request
at most one created issue
at most one comment per marker
unrecorded pushes, branch push route calls and label writes may repeat without changing the result
tests.pseudocode: for stages in gen_crash_sequences(): run_until_done(stages); assert forge.PRs<=1; assert forge.CreatedIssues<=1; for m in markers: assert forge.CommentsWith(m)<=1

tests.title: A resumed applied fix report takes one lease, re-measures once and lands without a brain round
given: an accepted and applied fix report not on hub's git server
tests.when: delivery 2 runs
then: the fake hub records one lease request
the scripted brain is not invoked
one pull request, one comment and the landed label result
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert hub.Count('lease')==1; assert brain.Invocations==0; assert forge.PRs==1 && forge.Comments==1; assert has(labels,'af:landed')

tests.title: A refused re-measure parks the change with no further brain round
given: an applied change that the gate on the re-measure refuses
tests.when: delivery 2 measures
then: the change is parked as fix.LandRun does
the scripted brain is not invoked
the job ends failed with the parked outcome
tests.pseudocode: gate.Refuse(); env=run(count=2); assert env.outcome=='parked'; assert brain.Invocations==0

tests.title: A missing baseline result is run again in the box with the change set aside and restored
given: the clone's .agent-fox/gate/<baselineId>/ removed before the resume
tests.when: delivery 2 measures
then: the baseline runs again in the box at the pinned base head with the pinned table
the run's change is set aside and restored afterwards
fix.json names the new baseline
the verdict is not unverified for lack of a baseline
tests.pseudocode: rm(gate/<id>); env=run(count=2); assert st.BaselineGateID!=oldID; assert exists(gate/newID); assert env.verdict!='unverified'; assert workingTreeEqualsChange()

tests.title: A resumed change that is empty once protected paths are restored ends failed with no_result not retryable
given: an applied change touching only protected paths
tests.when: delivery 2 re-measures
then: the envelope is failed with category no_result and retryable false
no branch is landed or parked
tests.pseudocode: env=run(count=2); assert env.error.category=='no_result' && !env.error.retryable; assert hub.Pushes()==0 && !anyLocalBranch

tests.title: A resumed accepted question takes no lease and the issue has exactly one question comment
given: a fix question and a triage question each accepted, delivery 1 having already posted the comment in one case
tests.when: delivery 2 runs
then: a needs_human envelope is returned
no lease request is made
the issue carries exactly one question comment for the attempt
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert env.status=='needs_human'; assert hub.Count('lease')==0; assert count(comments, marker)==1

tests.title: A resumed triage diagnosis lands again with a byte-identical Original report section and no lease
given: a triage attempt interrupted after its diagnosis was accepted
tests.when: delivery 2 runs
then: no lease is taken and the brain is not run
the new body's ## Original report section is byte-identical to the original body
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert section(newBody,'## Original report')==origBody; assert hub.Count('lease')==0

tests.title: A triage of text interrupted after issue creation lands into the same issue
given: a triage of text where hub created the issue and the journal recorded created_issue, stopped before the run's landing record
tests.when: delivery 2 calls triage.Land with the journal's issue as Created
then: that issue's body is replaced
the repository holds one issue, not two
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert forge.IssueCount()==1; assert forge.Issue(n).Body.contains('## Diagnosis')

tests.title: outcome.json exists marked not mirrored before the first mirror write and mirrored before the lease release
given: a fix attempt running through its mirror
tests.when: the delivery's hub and forge requests are observed in order
then: recovery/outcome.json (mode 0600) exists with mirrored false before the first label or comment write
each mirror step status_labels and comment is journalled as done
outcome.json is rewritten mirrored true with the amended envelope before the lease DELETE, usage, events and completion
tests.pseudocode: forge.OnFirstWrite(func(){ o=read(outcome); assert !o.Mirrored }); hub.OnDelete(func(){ o=read(outcome); assert o.Mirrored; assert stat(outcome).mode==0600 })

tests.title: A stored outcome is returned with only attempt_resumed added and no loop, no lease and no new session
given: delivery 1 stopped after the outcome was written but before the mirror, in one case, and after the mirror before the report in another
a failed attempt whose brain left no submission, stopped before the mirror
tests.when: delivery 2 runs
then: the stored envelope is returned with only attempt_resumed added
status label writes are repeated, and the comment is posted only when the marker is absent
the brain is not invoked and the fake hub records zero lease requests
unreleased leases are released and the existing session is completed without a new POST /sessions
tests.pseudocode: run(count=2); assert diff(env, stored)==[warn attempt_resumed]; assert brain.Invocations==0; assert hub.Count('lease')==0; assert hub.Count('POST /sessions')==1; assert count(comments,marker)<=1

tests.title: Only the delivery producing the outcome or finding it stored posts events and completes the session
given: an attempt interrupted by a shutdown, then a transient error, then finished by a third delivery
tests.when: all deliveries ran
then: the fake hub records at most one events batch sequence and exactly one session completion across all deliveries
tests.pseudocode: assert hub.Count('events batch seq')<=1; assert hub.Count('complete')==1

tests.title: Usage is posted once per completed attempt with the attempt's total
given: the fake hub with attempts interrupted at generated stages
tests.when: for any attempt interrupted at any sequence of stages and then completed
then: the fake hub records exactly one usage record per completed attempt, holding the attempt's total
no usage is posted again once the journal records usage_posted
tests.pseudocode: for plan in gen_interruptions(): run_all(plan); assert hub.Count('usage')==1; assert hub.Usage[0]==attemptTotal

tests.title: A gone or unreachable sandbox is recognisable with errors.Is while category, retryable flag and message are unchanged
given: box failures from tool code sandbox_unavailable, a gateway not-found answer, a lease-expired answer, an unreachable gateway and other sandbox failures
tests.when: errors.Is is checked against the box-loss sentinel and Failure fields are compared with the pre-change values

tests.title: The first box loss is replaced in place: the lost lease is released, a new lease taken, the clone synced and the recorder told
given: the fake hub makes the leased sandbox unavailable during a brain tool call
tests.when: the delivery reaches the loss
then: fix.Finish does not park or land the interrupted work
the lost lease is DELETEd (a 404 counts as released) and the journal records the loss
a new lease with the pinned profile and same purpose is taken, the box opened and the clone synced
the envelope carries box_replaced naming both sandbox ids and the job's hub.sandbox_id is the new box's

tests.title: A failed release of the lost lease is logged at WARN and left to reconciliation

a WARN line is logged
the journal records the lost lease as unreleased

tests.title: After replacement an applied change is measured without a brain run, otherwise the loop reruns with the remaining budget

tests.title: A second loss or a refused or unopenable replacement ends the delivery as a retryable transient sandbox error
given: the sandbox lost twice in one delivery, then in other cases the replacement lease refused or the replacement box unopenable
tests.when: the delivery runs
then: the runner returns an error carrying toolio.Failure with category sandbox and retryable true
